description: This file contains helper functions and classes for interacting with the Intrinio API, including request handling, response processing, and data retrieval functions, as well as a BasicResponse class and utility functions for date handling.

classes.name: BasicResponse
classes.description: A class representing a basic HTTP response, encapsulating status code and response text, with a method to parse JSON content.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URL using pyodide's open_url and returns a BasicResponse object.

methods.name: response_callback
methods.description: Asynchronous callback to process the response JSON, handle errors, and return data.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches data from the Intrinio API endpoint asynchronously.

methods.name: get_data_many
methods.description: Retrieves data from Intrinio API and extracts a sub-dictionary if specified, returning a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: get_data_one
methods.description: Retrieves a single data item from Intrinio API, converting list responses to a dictionary.

methods.name: get_weekday
methods.description: Adjusts a date to the nearest weekday if it falls on a weekend.

methods.name: async_get_data_one
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a single data item, with optional rate limiting via sleep.
